purpose: Target-scoped preinvestment literature-gap warrants. Broad proof-search investment is blocked unless an avenue has a validated warrant with enough novelty, field impact, unification power, and route-decision power.

warrants.avenue_title: Target-preserving P vs NP bridge route

closest_known_results.limitation_for_this_avenue: It does not provide lower-bound machinery for separating P from NP.
closest_known_results.relevance: Introduces NP-completeness through SAT and makes reductions the central target-preserving language.
closest_known_results.title: The complexity of theorem-proving procedures

closest_known_results.limitation_for_this_avenue: It is a barrier criterion, not a complete prohibition on all nonnatural or proof-complexity routes.
closest_known_results.relevance: Shows why many circuit lower-bound properties collide with pseudorandomness assumptions.
closest_known_results.title: Natural proofs

closest_known_results.limitation_for_this_avenue: It does not rule out every proof-complexity, meta-complexity, or highly nonblackbox route.
closest_known_results.relevance: Extends relativization-style concerns and forces routes to state how they escape algebraic oracle worlds.
closest_known_results.title: Algebrization: A new barrier in complexity theory

closest_known_results.limitation_for_this_avenue: It is not a direct P vs NP separation and still leaves target-preserving amplification gaps.
closest_known_results.relevance: Illustrates the modern algorithms-to-lower-bounds frontier and the need for exact model and quantifier accounting.
closest_known_results.title: Circuit lower bounds for nondeterministic quasi-polytime

disqualifier_matrix.test: The branch cites natural proofs, relativization, or algebrization without checking the exact property or oracle/algebraic interface.
The bridge selects hard objects, rows, formulas, or certificates nonuniformly without paying advice.
Known lower-bound, proof-complexity, or meta-complexity literature already proves the bridge under the same assumptions.

explicit_unknowns: Whether the source lower-bound object is independently easier than the target separation.
Whether the bridge preserves the target class without hidden advice.
Whether the route has a scoped no-go theorem that is more valuable than another proof attempt.
warrants.gap_statement: The relevant research gap is a sharply typed bridge that avoids known barrier and quantifier leaks. The current workflow must prove, disprove, or quarantine such a bridge rather than accumulate partial analogies.
warrants.mathematical_or_physical_object: Boolean complexity bridge object connecting restricted lower-bound, proof-complexity, meta-complexity, or formula-footprint evidence to the main P vs NP target.
warrants.novelty_boundary: Novelty cannot be 'another P vs NP route'. It must be the exact bridge theorem, obstruction lemma, parameter calculation, or disqualifier test not already covered by known reductions and barriers.

physics_or_field_impact.claim: For complexity theory, impact means changing how a lower-bound route transfers to the Boolean main problem under barriers.
physics_or_field_impact.evidence: The route touches reductions, proof complexity, lower bounds, and barrier-aware transfer.
physics_or_field_impact.missing: A checked theorem or no-go statement for the exact bridge object.

relevance_threshold.criterion: Invest broadly only when a concrete bridge theorem or obstruction lemma can be stated with quantified transfer.
relevance_threshold.evidence: The route family is important, but most branch outputs remain at risk of moving proof debt into the bridge.

route_decision_power.decides: Whether the next cycle should prove a scoped bridge/no-go theorem or reframe the gap before more broad exploration.
route_decision_power.next_decisive_test: State the source theorem, target theorem, parameter map, barrier status, and one falsifier or countermodel for the bridge.

warrants.smallest_honest_claim: A P vs NP avenue is investable only if it names a target-preserving source object, target class, reduction or proof-system interface, quantifier regime, and barrier status before any global separation rhetoric.

unification_power.mechanism: One typed bridge could unify restricted lower bounds, proof-system evidence, quantifier transfer, and barrier status.
unification_power.new_requirement_exposed: The bridge must expose length regime, exponent window, reduction direction, and advice status as first-class obligations.

warrants.why_not_already_known: Classical NP-completeness and barrier literature frames the target and common obstructions, while modern lower-bound frontiers show restricted progress. The local avenue has not yet demonstrated a bridge that survives model, advice, and exponent transfer.
